correctness.rationale: The proposed rational five-vector (Sh,Ih,Rh,Sv,Iv)=(1313/1500,1/10,2/3,101/200,1/10) is strictly positive. Direct independent Fraction evaluation of all five published vector-field right-hand sides gives zero at the stated positive rates; source R0²=9581/10000<1. The host sum 821/500 is below Λh/μh=871/500 and the vector sum 121/200 equals Λv/μv, so the stationary witness is inside the stated biological region. A distinct stationary trajectory cannot converge to the disease-free state; hence Theorem 3.3 as globally stated is false. At this stationary state the printed formula (3.8) evaluates to −264869/3030000, though the true derivative of differentiable Lyapunov L at equilibrium is zero; this additionally disproves the printed identity. Both are exact calculations, not numerical approximations.
